description: Use when the user asks to find, show, attend, watch, visit, or buy tickets for an event or session—not when they need to hire talent. For example, 'find an analogue listening session in Melbourne' uses this tool; 'analogue listening sessions looking for organisers' uses search_open_calls. Search first-party upcoming live events submitted directly to the Open Call Portals Live Events Map. Includes DJ sets, live bands, comedy nights, and more with geo coordinates (lat/lng), ticketing info, source links, and event start/end times. All events are future or currently in progress.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD — events on or after this date.

genre.description: Optional exact canonical override only; omit when inferred from query. Comma-separated canonical genres, e.g. 'house,techno,drum-bass'.

location.description: City, venue name, or country substring, e.g. 'london', 'chicago', 'uk'.

query.description: Pass the complete original natural-language event discovery request, e.g. 'techno events in Amsterdam tonight'. Prefer query-only rather than guessing type or genre; the server maps phrases to authoritative live-event values.

to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD — events on or before this date.

type.description: Optional exact canonical override only. Omit it when the format is expressed naturally in query. Canonical examples include dj, live-band, comedian, dance-act, snooker-tournament, and analog-listening. Do not infer type from genre: 'techno events' means genre='techno' with type omitted.

name: search_live_events
